name: Beyond AI Tools

sources.title: Homepage — live multilingual AI tools directory with Submit nav
Submit/pricing page — Basic $9.9 one-submit, Standard $29.9 one-submit; no free tier

requirements: AI-related products only; must meet editorial and legal standards
No NSFW/adult content; no products infringing third-party IP
Payment required: Basic $9.9 one-time (listing, ~3-day turnaround) or Standard $29.9 one-time (adds 2-week site-wide promotion)
Submission needs product name, category, and a valid URL
Payments via Stripe (cards, PayPal, Apple Pay)
preparation: Product name, category, and live URL
Stripe-compatible payment method for the one-time fee
Marketing copy — Basic tier advertises a 'fine crafted introduction' written by them
workflow: Pick Basic ($9.9) or Standard ($29.9) and hit Submit Now
Provide product name, category, and URL; pay via Stripe
Manual review; listing is published within ~3 days of receiving complete information
Rejected submissions are auto-refunded in full
watchFor: No free submission tier at all — both plans are paid one-time fees
The 3-day clock only starts once they have 'complete and accurate' info — incomplete submissions stall the timeline
Claims of '10 valuable dofollow backlinks' come via dedicated pages in 10 languages — verify the language pages actually link out
Sponsored top banners on every page are paid placements (utm_source=paid_referral)
Listings never expire but can be removed for policy violations
countsAsLive: The product has a public detail page on beyondaitools.com (and its language variants) linked from category pages
unknowns: Whether the '10+ dofollow backlinks' are all same-domain language variants or external
Exact editorial criteria beyond NSFW/IP exclusions
Whether an account is needed to submit (a Log in link exists)
